title: Comparative Analysis of Constituency Parsers: A Case Study on Stanford U-PCFG and Berkeley Neural Parsers
abstract: Bracketing F-score is a useful proxy of parser quality but hides where systems actually fail. This report combines quantitative and qualitative evaluation of the Berkeley Neural Parser (Kitaev & Klein, 2018; Kitaev et al., 2019) and the Stanford Unlexicalized PCFG Parser (Klein & Manning, 2003), characterizing their behavior on a designated test set across error types, precision/recall, and parsing time.
